judged_text: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:9 — The route accepts malformed or off-host embed_url values as a loading success even though the worker rejects them, leaving the iframe in a permanent reload loop.

record.issue_text: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:9 — The route accepts malformed or off-host embed_url values as a loading success even though the worker rejects them, leaving the iframe in a permanent reload loop.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, in embed_controller.rb:best action (lines 8-18), when topic_id is nil (no existing embed found), it enqueues a RetrieveTopic job and renders 'loading'. The loading.html.erb template sets up a 30-second auto-reload. However, in topic_retriever.rb, the perform_retrieve method checks if the host matches SiteSetting.embeddable_host (invalid_host? method). If the embed_url has a different host than embeddable_host, the retriever silently returns without creating a TopicEmbed. This means the controller will keep rendering 'loading' and the iframe will reload every 30 seconds indefinitely for off-host URLs. The finding correctly identifies this as a permanent reload loop for malformed/off-host URLs.
